approach.text: A mole sits hunched against the cavern wall, wrapped tightly in a tattered cloak. A large bottle glows faintly at his side. He looks up with red-rimmed eyes. 'Please... I lost everything in the lower tunnels. My cart, my tools — gone. All I have left is this tonic. I brewed it myself. It's worth ten times what I'm asking. Fourteen coins and it's yours. I just need to get my family out of here.'

choices.text: Pay 14 coins for the Mole's Endurance Tonic.
Grab the bottle while he's distracted.

sold.text: He exhales slowly, eyes glistening. 'You're a good soul. Bless you.' He places the bottle in your hands with trembling care, then gathers himself and heads deeper into the warren.

caught.text: You reach for the bottle — and the mole explodes upright with a roar that echoes off the stone walls. 'NOT TODAY!' His grief transforms into fury. He snatches the bottle back and plants his feet, claws spread wide.

items.name: Acid Splash
items.description: Hurls a vial of corrosive brew.
